build_crf_transition_graph: build a bigram transition graph for a linear-chain CRF with a given number of classes
build_crf_potential_graph: build a unary potential graph mapping input features to output classes for a CRF model
build_crf_model: build a CRF model with random arc weights for potentials and transitions graphs
run_crf_training: run SGD training on a linear-chain CRF model using sampled training data and gradient updates
compute_crf_loss: compute the CRF loss by composing feature graphs and calculating forward scores for normalization
